name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.296.0 — the host declares its file shapes: grounding contract gains the optional fileShapes block (testGlobs, codeExtensions, manifests over stack-neutral defaults in lib/file-shapes.js); every script classifies tests, code and manifests through it; /spec:init profiles and writes the block and /spec:doctor check 1 proves each declared test glob with init-gen shapes-check. 7.295.0 — grounding contract gains the optional testCaseScanner key: a host command listing its own test cases (<file> :: <title> or JSON with start/end) so non-JavaScript stacks resolve, count and expire cases; /spec:init profiles the runner's case shape and /spec:doctor proves the listing with count-tests --scanner-check. 7.294.0 — commit-coverage.js derives the escape-row pick from the file the root cause names (--primary), falling back to the latest review among files not landed by every other entry's top spec.
